brief:
An Israeli raid near Gaza City forced a kindergarten to evacuate approximately 200 children amid gunfire and heavy bombardment, according to Zeteo. School principals scrambled to calm the young students and move them to safety as the military operation unfolded in the vicinity of their facility.

Zeteo interviewed the kindergarten leadership on the ground in Gaza City, who described the frantic evacuation during the attack. The principals had to manage the fear and confusion of young children while coordinating their movement away from the site under fire. Staff worked to keep the evacuees organized and moving swiftly despite the chaotic circumstances surrounding the operation.
dek: On the ground in Gaza City, Zeteo speaks to the principals of a nursery school who had to calm young children and get them to safety amid Israeli gunfire and heavy bombardment near their school.
title: Israeli raid forces Gaza kindergarten to evacuate 200 children
